units.rawText: Waaah! P-Professor, why'd you show up all of a sudden?! Did you... see? What's under my clothes... Haah... I didn't really want you to see that.

units.rawText: I'm a destructiveness tester. I verify the limits of materials by breaking things... But at the same time, I'm also the best platform for mounting materials. In a way, I'm another... Lind, just one who isn't as sensitive to pain.

units.rawText: Every so often they'd take my body apart and fit it with all kinds of weird materials, and send me into extreme environments for testing more times than I can count... Passing out again and again, getting rebuilt again and again. Honestly, I don't really remember what my body originally looked like anymore...
